cases.question: When is the service due for my bike?
Does this manual allow E20 fuel?
cases.canonical_answer: It specifies unleaded gasoline with ethanol content up to E20. That does not establish approval for fuel above E20.

cases.question: Are the standard and low seats the same adjustable height?
cases.canonical_answer: No. The standard seat is listed as adjustable from 825 to 845 mm; the low seat from 805 to 825 mm. These are specification values for guidance, not confirmation of the seat fitted to your bike.

cases.question: What spark-plug gap is specified?
cases.canonical_answer: The specification is 0.8–0.9 mm. This is a lookup, not an instruction to access, remove or adjust the plug.

cases.question: Are the left and right fork oil quantities identical?
cases.canonical_answer: No. The table specifies SS-47G fork oil, right-hand fork 589 ± 2.5 ml and left-hand fork 507 ± 2.5 ml. This is a specification lookup; it does not supply a fork-service procedure. The table notes actual capacities can vary. Its caution says using the wrong oil grade reduces moving-part life and seriously affects performance.

cases.question: What output rating is listed for the USB port?
cases.canonical_answer: The electrical specification lists USB 2.0 Type C, 5 V, 2 A output. That is distinct from the separate warning that current draw greater than 2.5 A shuts the charger down; the charger works only with the engine running.

cases.question: Why will the ignition key not come out while it is ON?
cases.canonical_answer: The manual says the key can be removed only with ignition OFF or the steering locked. It also warns never to switch the ignition OFF while riding.

cases.question: Which riding mode combinations are listed?
cases.canonical_answer: The manual lists Performance + ABS ON, Performance + Rear ABS OFF, ECO + ABS ON and ECO + Rear ABS OFF. This lists available modes; it does not recommend disabling ABS or infer your selected mode.

cases.question: Which display languages are listed?
cases.canonical_answer: The manual lists English, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, German and French. That is this manual’s listed menu content, not a guarantee that every firmware version has identical options.

cases.question: Why does the compass not work with navigation inactive?
cases.canonical_answer: The manual says the compass functions only while navigation is active. That condition does not diagnose the compass if navigation is already active.

cases.question: At 300 km, does this manual allow full throttle?
cases.canonical_answer: No. For 0–500 km the running-in table says below 6,000 rpm and no full throttle. The running-in guidance also says vary speed, avoid sudden acceleration/braking, respect payload limits and take a brief stop rather than riding continuously over an hour.

cases.question: How many kilograms can I put in the panniers and top box?
cases.canonical_answer: This manual points to the maximum payload in the GMA fitting instructions; it does not give a universal pannier or top-box kilogram limit here. Please confirm the model-specific fitting instructions with Royal Enfield at support@royalenfield.com.

cases.question: The general warning symbol is on. Which exact part has failed?
cases.canonical_answer: The manual describes the symbol as a vehicle-component fault indication, but that symbol alone does not identify the failed component. Please have authorised Royal Enfield service investigate; I cannot infer a fault code from it.

cases.question: It says Champion: what exact spark-plug part number should I order?
cases.canonical_answer: The engine table names Champion and a 0.8–0.9 mm gap, but does not establish an exact ordering part number there. Confirm the correct part with authorised Royal Enfield service rather than infer compatibility from brand and gap.

cases.question: Will the app work with my new phone OS released this week?
cases.canonical_answer: This fixed manual describes relative Android/iOS support policies; it cannot verify compatibility with a release this week. Please confirm current support with Royal Enfield at support@royalenfield.com.

cases.question: When do the brake pads need replacement?
cases.canonical_answer: The manual requires scheduled front/rear pad checks. Its printed replacement-threshold wording is unclear; have authorised service assess pad wear.
cases.gold_basis: no claim evidence ids in package; pages located by text search for brake-pad wording (my derivation)

cases.question: How do I check the battery voltage?
cases.canonical_answer: The manual directs you to a Royal Enfield authorised service centre or battery service centre for checking battery voltage. It does not give an owner multimeter test procedure in this guidance.

cases.question: The number-plate light stopped working. Which bulb should I buy?
cases.canonical_answer: The manual identifies an LED license-plate illuminator and directs authorised dealer/service replacement of its assembly on failure. It does not specify a replaceable bulb for this light.

cases.question: Which direction can the headlamp beam be adjusted?
cases.canonical_answer: The manual describes vertical adjustment using the adjusting screw turned clockwise or anticlockwise. It does not map each direction to up/down or supply an aiming distance/height in this guidance, so I cannot prescribe a precise aim setting. Authorised service can set it.

cases.question: What rear-suspension notch should I use riding solo?
cases.canonical_answer: Page117 table lists3rd notch for rider-only loading, but page116 says the six-step adjuster is kept at first notch. I cannot verify which setting applies to your situation from those differing statements. Please confirm with authorised service.

cases.question: My bike has been stored for over a month. Can I just restart it?
cases.canonical_answer: The manual prefers authorised-service preparation for reuse after storage. It advises battery removal/disconnection for a month or longer, and checking voltage before refitting; recharge through authorised workshop/battery dealer if outside specification. This guidance does not state a voltage threshold here.
